caseName: Jones v. Illinois ex rel. Electoral Board
caseNameFull: Jones v. Illinois By Its Electoral Board
attorneys: William J. Scott, Attorney General of Illinois, and Francis T. Crowe, Herman Tavins, and A. Zola Groves, Assistant Attorneys General, in opposition.

opinions.text:
395 U. S. 162. Motion to require state and local officials of Illinois promptly to conduct an election for office of Lieutenant Governor of Illinois denied.

The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
